answers.decision: Data is intentionally ephemeral and may be lost whenever the backend restarts.
Use the simplest safe role-provisioning approach; the Planner is authorized to choose and document it.

A recruit may create, view, edit, and delete only their own diary entries. A manager may create, view, edit, and delete diary entries for assigned recruits. An admin may create, view, edit, and delete all diary entries and manage users.
Admins create and change manager-to-recruit assignments.
Users may edit their own profile. Use basic email-pattern and date validation. Role and oversight changes remain admin-managed.
Issues, feedback, and notes support create, view, edit, and delete. Recruits operate on their own records; managers operate on assigned recruits' records; admins operate on all records.
The Planner is authorized to define minimal enums, required fields, lengths, date rules, and tag rules using simple judgment.
The Planner is authorized to define minimal dashboard scope, ordering, limits, completion calculation, and open-status rules using simple judgment.
The Planner is authorized to define a minimal report contract, including columns, ordering, inclusive date behavior, filenames, CSV/PDF formatting, and empty results.
Use simple username/password authentication. The Planner is authorized to select the simplest reasonable session, password, logout, and failed-login behavior.
The Planner is authorized to define a minimal JSON REST API contract without unnecessary complexity.
Do not implement the two additional features in this MVP. Record them as explicitly deferred until the core MVP is complete and proven.
The Planner is authorized to define a minimal responsive-browser/viewport matrix and simple user-visible failure behavior.

approval_policy: The corrected plan still requires human approval before generation.
